lines.zh: 我一步一步穿过斑驳的树影。
lines.en: I move through the dappled tree shadow, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的动作很轻，像没有体重。
lines.en: I move lightly, as if weightless.
I jog through the understory.
My tail brushes the rotting leaves.
My head sways left and right.
I follow the stream up.

lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，几乎不响。
lines.en: I walk on leaf litter almost soundlessly.

lines.zh: 我从一片阴影走到另一片。
lines.en: I go from one patch of shadow to the next.
I round the roots of a big tree.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，为了不惊动。
lines.en: I go slowly, so as not to startle anything.

lines.zh: 我顺着一条小径往深处。
lines.en: I follow a path deeper in.
I lower my head under a branch.
I pause, then move again.

lines.zh: 我走到林子最暗的地方。
lines.en: I walk to the darkest part of the wood.
I crouch and draw myself down.
My tail moves along the ground.
I stare at one direction without moving.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔很小，动得很快。
lines.en: My nostrils are small and quick.

lines.zh: 我在等树上的东西下来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to come down from the tree.
I keep myself carefully hidden.
My body lies close to the ground.
I stay still; I'm hard to find.
I'm listening to the soil underfoot.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，什么都没看到。
lines.en: I raise my head and see nothing.
I change my stance slowly.
My legs are always tense.
When the wind moves, I freeze.

lines.zh: 你正踩在我的巡游线上。
lines.en: You're standing on my roaming line.
My two eyes sit on either side of my head.
Your boot snapped a branch.
I'm deciding whether to act.
You're bigger. That doesn't matter.
Step back and I needn't move.
One bite still draws blood.
You still haven't seen me.
I was in this wood first.
I spring away into the shadow.
My leg has gone numb.
My cry startles the birds from the trees.

lines.zh: 这样一道伤就要我半条命。
lines.en: A wound like this costs me dearly.
I pull back along the ground.
I shook once and lost balance.
I hide behind the tree.
My thin legs still obey me.
That is the smell of meat.
That won't fill me.

lines.zh: 小恐龙闻到你手上的肉。
lines.en: A little raptor smells meat on your hands.
I can wait a while.
There is something off about this.
Light-footed, I test a step first.
I lift my head to sniff.
Is that meat for me?
You bumped me and I sprang away.
My body hardly has any weight.
You almost trod on me.
Now we are far too close.
I caught on a vine.
Two kicks and I dropped free.
You've pushed me out of the shadow.
I back behind the tree.
That put me on edge.
A few of us hide together.
They're all in the tree shadow.
I know their smell.
We lie in wait apart.
It holds its patience better than I do.
We never meet face to face.
One small sound and it moves.
It ran first; I followed.
We surround that patch of brush.
We each got a small share.
I pick up a small piece.
I drag it under the roots.
I can't get my teeth into this.
I bring my snout close and sniff twice.
This has soil on it.
I carry it off a stretch.
I come back for the rest.
I bite. Put me down.
The grass ahead just moved.
I press forward, low.
It isn't watching this side.
I slip out from under the fallen log.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从落叶上滑过去。
lines.en: I drop low and glide over the fallen leaves.
The wind comes off it.
It suddenly turned around.
I hold dead still.
Too close; it will hear me.
I shift to the other side.
Just a moment more.
My hind legs are already tense.
This bite is going to land properly.
I trail along at grass-root height.
I only move once it's gone ahead.
I wait behind a tree for it to come back.
I've taken a wide circle.
While it had its head down, I got closer.
I'm downwind of it.
It stops, I stop; it moves, I move.
It's caught some scent.
I sink almost flat to the ground.
The tree shadow is my cover.
It's moving off.
Just wait for it to turn away.
I count the distance tile by tile.
Two more steps will do.
I bite into its hind leg.
One pass of my claws.
I retreat into the shadow at once.
That bite didn't go deep.
My foreclaws clamp around your calf.
I spring onto its back.
It rolls and I let go.
That'll feed me for a day.
I pull back with a limp.
It's far stronger than me.
In the end I left.
I watch it go from behind a tree.
I'll remember this one.
I'll wait for the next chance.
I come out from under a fallen log.
The wood is quiet. Perfect.
First I find cover.
My body is almost flat to the soil.

lines.zh: 我十四点生命，常成群走。
lines.en: Fourteen health; I travel in groups.
I shake the leaf litter off me.
The wind comes down through the trees.
I choose the darkest patch.
My toes grip the ground.
I start moving deeper in.
The shadows swallow me.
I'm ready for my first strike.
I sink low and stop moving.
I wait for that one step.
In firelight there's nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我从枝上滑落，摔在软叶上。
lines.en: I slip from a branch onto soft leaves.
My nose fills; I flounder.
The blast scatters the shadows.

lines.zh: 肋侧的羽毛被削掉一撮。
lines.en: An arrow shaves a tuft of feathers off my ribs.
Light strips away my cover.
Too little prey; my legs tremble.

lines.zh: 白光一闪，我立刻缩进树根。
lines.en: A white flash and I curl under the roots.
No trees here, and no shadow.
